article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Asim Djulovic's 19 points helped Butler defeat Lafayette 96-60 on Monday in a season opener. Djulovic shot 5 for 7 (4 for 6 from 3-point range) and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line for the Bulldogs. Jalen Jackson scored 18 points while going 7 of 10 (4 for 6 from 3-point range), and added five rebounds, five assists, and three steals. Jordan Ellerbee had 16 points and shot 6 for 8, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc. Shareef Jackson led the way for the Leopards with 14 points. Butler took the lead with 19:21 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Djulovic led his team in scoring with 14 points in the first half to help put them up 54-34 at the break. Butler outscored Lafayette in the second half by 16 points, with Ellerbee scoring a team-high 10 points after the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
